movie.title: In Cold Light
movie.overview: Fresh out of prison, Ava's attempt to reclaim her drug operation collapses when she witnesses a brutal crime, forcing her to flee into a nightmarish underworld where allies are scarce and enemies multiply by the minute.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Fresh out of prison, Ava attempts to reclaim her former drug operation, only to end up framed for her twin brother's murder and forced into a desperate fight for survival against ruthless enemies and corrupt law enforcement.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: After serving time in prison, Ava returns home intent on reclaiming her position in the local drug trade. Her plan falls apart when she witnesses the murder of her twin brother, Tom, by a corrupt police officer and his accomplice. Framed for the killing, Ava is forced on the run through a nightmarish, neon-lit underworld. Hunted by both law enforcement and an unyielding crime syndicate, she must rely on sheer survival instincts while navigating complex family ties to stay alive.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Upon her release from a two-year prison sentence, Ava returns to her hometown in Alberta with the goal of re-establishing control over her former drug empire. However, the criminal landscape has dramatically shifted in her absence, now dominated by an icy, formidable crime boss named Claire. Matters take a dark turn when Ava tries to reconnect with her twin brother, Tom, and arrange a meeting to settle old scores. En route, they are ambushed by a dirty cop, Bob, and his son, who brutally murder Tom on the spot. Realizing Ava is a witness, the killers frame her for her brother's murder to cover their tracks. Overnight, Ava becomes a target for both corrupt law enforcement seeking to silence her and Claire's syndicate trying to protect their territory. Forced to flee into the dark corners of the city, she seeks shelter while attempting to clear her name and confront her past, including her estranged deaf father, Will. Across a tense, real-time pursuit through an urban rodeo landscape, Ava uses her resourcefulness to stay one step ahead of her pursuers. Ultimately, her frantic journey shifts from a quest for power and vengeance to a fight for total personal freedom and self-preservation.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: In Cold Light follows Ava, a former drug operator who has just served two years in prison and is eager to reclaim her territory. Returning to a fractured world where her old criminal network has moved on without her, Ava faces immediate resistance from ruthless new powers in the underworld. Her attempt at a fresh start implodes when she witnesses her twin brother's sudden, violent murder at the hands of a corrupt police officer and is subsequently framed for the crime. Suddenly a target for both a relentless police search and a cold-blooded crime boss looking to tie up loose ends, Ava is thrust into a high-stakes, nightmarish chase through the city's neon-lit underbelly. As she navigates shifting alliances, corrupt authority figures, and deeply buried family trauma, Ava must rely on her sharp survival instincts to outwit her pursuers before time runs out.
